assertions.name: S_sign_flips_across_anchors_at_central_values
assertions.source: S(muon) > 0 > S(proton) AT THE CENTRAL VALUES. Scoped deliberately: see the next assertion — this does NOT survive the CAL-3 uncertainty, so it must not be cited as an established sign flip

assertions.name: swing_is_resolved_but_sign_flip_is_not
assertions.source: the CAL-3 error is common to both anchors, so it cancels in S(muon) - S(proton) (resolved to ~1.5e-5 relative) and not in the individual values (~130x the value). Asserted as the FINDING: the swing is real, the sign flip is not established by this data

assertions.name: claim_odd_part_cannot_sign_flip
assertions.source: the claim formula's odd part is anchor-blind and keeps one sign, which is what excludes it

description: CANONICAL SOURCE for the bar-odd S-leak anchor values S = c_3 + Vol(4_1), which QOU/QBeta/SLeakZeroCrossing.lean, MonodromyDatumRigidity.lean and CompleteStructureExclusion.lean cite and which at least four Python probes had hand-copied as bare 6-digit literals. This probe previously emitted NO witness, so there was nothing to read instead — the copies were the only carrier. It also computed in float64 despite 12-digit string inputs. Both fixed: mpmath throughout, and the values are published here with the digit count the c_3 + Vol(4_1) cancellation actually supports. Derives nothing new; it is the same computation, sourced.

cal3_uncertainty_propagation.amplification: c_3 = (Q_codata/Q_N2 - 1)/u^3 with u ~ 8.5e-3, so 1/u^3 ~ 1.6e6 multiplies the input error
cal3_uncertainty_propagation.reading: The error is FULLY CORRELATED across anchors — the same Q_beta(n) enters both — so it cancels in the difference and does not cancel in the individual values. Consequence: the 2.43% SWING is resolved to ~1.5e-5 relative and is a real feature; the individual anchor values are not resolved at all (uncertainty ~130x the value), and therefore NEITHER IS THE SIGN FLIP. At Q + 1 sigma both S are positive; at Q - 1 sigma both are negative. The zero crossing between the anchors is a property of the central value, not of the data.
cal3_uncertainty_propagation.bears_on: QOU/QBeta/SLeakZeroCrossing.lean states that 'the anchor signs are the only empirical input' to sleak_zero_between_anchors and sign_definite_carrier_excluded. Those theorems remain valid — they are conditional on the signs — but the hypothesis they are conditioned on is NOT established by this data. Their APPLICABILITY is open, not their correctness.

precision.WARNING_arithmetic_not_uncertainty: the digit count below is ARITHMETIC precision from the 12-digit upstream strings. It is NOT the uncertainty — see cal3_uncertainty_propagation, which is ~11 orders of magnitude larger. Do not cite these digits as accuracy.
precision.why: S = c_3 + Vol(4_1) subtracts two quantities agreeing to their first two digits, so S carries fewer significant figures than its inputs. Reporting S at the inputs' 12 digits would be fake precision; the 6-digit literal the consumers copied is the opposite error.

sign_flip.scope: the zero-crossing is an INFERENCE from continuity (IVT), and the fraction is a linear-interpolation estimate of its location, not a computed q*
